stories.title: Welsh Government sets out spending priorities in first budget since Plaid Cymru took office
stories.summary: The Welsh Government is set to publish its First Supplementary Budget for 2026-27 later today, the first financial statement from the Plaid Cymru administration since it took office following May’s Senedd election. stories.title: North Wales Police officer suspended after being charged with sexual offence
stories.summary: A North Wales Police detective constable has been suspended from duties after being charged with a sexual offence following an incident in the Colwyn Bay area. Detective Constable Harshey-Jones was arrested in connection with an incident on Thursday 11 June. stories.title: A wall collapsed on a man in Padeswood, one of two rescues for NEWSAR on Father’s Day
stories.summary: North East Wales Search and Rescue volunteers responded to two separate incidents on Father’s Day Sunday, including a man injured when a wall collapsed onto him in Padeswood. stories.title: Fire at Widnes waste site declared major incident, smoke visible from Deeside
stories.summary: A large fire at a waste facility in Widnes is producing a heavy smoke plume visible from Deeside, with Cheshire Fire and Rescue Service declaring a major incident 6pm on Monday 22 June. stories.title: Connah’s Quay teen to fly to USA to compete for Great Britain in inline hockey
stories.summary: A 13-year-old from Connah’s Quay has been selected to represent Great Britain in inline hockey and will travel to the United States in July to compete in two tournaments.
